title: Why Japanese People Put Cash on a Tray at the Register
seo_title: Why Japanese People Put Cash on a Tray at the Register
description: At many Japanese registers, cash goes on a small tray called a karuton, not into an open palm. Learn how counting, change, hygiene, IC cards, and the absence of tipping shape the habit.
